data.description_en:
Product type: Ready-to-eat refrigerated food ❄️
Net weight: 380g ⚖️
Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

This wrap keeps things rich, without shouting.

House-made plant-based chicken strips bring chew and depth, paired with roasted sweet bell peppers and juicy fresh tomatoes.

Leafy greens add lift, while fermented cashew sour cream and pumpkin seed pesto hold everything together.

Rolled tight in a whole wheat tortilla and built to satisfy.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE IT 🌾

It’s balanced, filling, and easy to enjoy.

The seasoning stays gentle, letting the ingredients speak.

A wrap that works across tastes without losing character.

INGREDIENTS 🌱

Garlic sauce, plant-based chicken strips, tomato, roasted red bell pepper, onion, lettuce, probiotic cashew sour cream, pickled onion, whole wheat tortilla

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: Wheat, Tree nuts (cashew)
May contain traces of: Soy, Seeds

HOW TO EAT 🍽️

This wrap is best enjoyed heated.

Warm it in an oven, pan, or air fryer until the outside turns lightly crisp.

A microwave works if needed, but the crisp won’t be there.

STORAGE & SHELF LIFE ❄️

Storage: Keep refrigerated at 0–4°C at all times
Shelf life: See packaging

NUTRITION (PER SERVING) 🧮

Energy 435kcal
Fat 24.1g
Carbohydrate 22.5g
Protein 33.3g

INTENDED USE / NOTES 📌

Plant-based product 🌿
Mild seasoning profile
data.description_cn:
产品类型：即食冷藏食品 ❄️
净含量：380g ⚖️
产地：中国广州 🌍

产品描述 🧾

这一卷走的是浓郁路线，但不张扬。

自制的素鸡肉条口感扎实有弹性，搭配烤制后的甜椒和多汁的新鲜番茄。

绿叶蔬菜带来清爽，我们用发酵腰果酸奶油和南瓜子青酱把所有味道稳稳收住。

卷进全麦卷饼里，一口下去很满足。

为什么人们会选它 🌾

整体平衡、饱腹，但不厚重。

香料感温和，让食材本身站在前面。

是一款不挑人的卷，但也有自己的性格。

配料表 🌱

香蒜酱、素鸡肉条、西红柿、烤红甜椒、洋葱、生菜、益生菌腰果酸奶油、腌洋葱、全麦卷饼

致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：小麦、坚果制品（腰果）
可能含有微量：大豆、种子类

食用方式 🍽️

这款卷饼更推荐加热后食用。

可使用烤箱、平底锅或空气炸锅加热，至外层略微酥脆。

如条件有限可使用微波炉，但外皮不会产生酥感。

贮存与保质期 ❄️

贮存条件：全程 0–4°C 冷藏保存
保质期：见包装标示

营养信息（每份）🧮

能量 435kcal
脂肪 24.1g
碳水化合物 22.5g
蛋白质 33.3g

食用提示 📌

植物性食品 🌿
调味温和，适合大多数口味
